description: Set the value of clump CFD attributes. This command is a synonym for the clump cfd initialize command. Individual attributes can be listed with the clump cfd list command, and all clump CFD attributes can be visualized.

keywords.name: force
keywords.description: Force applied by fluid to the clump or the drag force. Options: add <f>: Add f to the existing value.; gradient <v>: Apply a linear gradient in each of the axes directions starting at the origin.; gradient-x <f>: Apply a linear gradient in the \(x\) -direction starting at the origin.; gradient-y <f>: Apply a linear gradient in the \(y\) -direction starting at the origin.; gradient-z <f>: Apply a linear gradient in the \(z\) -direction starting at the origin.; multiply <f>: Multiply the existing value by f.; replace <f>: Replace the existing value with f.

keywords.name: porosity
keywords.description: Porosity contribution mode. If true (the default), the clump contributes to the porosity of the CFD element associated with it.

notes: The 7.0/9.0 manuals attach a post-value modifier block (add, gradient, gradient-x/y/z, multiply, replace) to the value; live, trailing modifier tokens error as unused parameters on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 - and the base value is still applied before the error.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): force vectors set and read back exactly via clump.cfd.force.x on all three consoles; the porosity flag accepted both ways.
